title: Dolphins LT Patrick Paul: Maxx Crosby is a hothead, have to get him off his game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dolphins LT Patrick Paul: Maxx Crosby is a hothead, have to get him off his game
sources.description: When the Dolphins hosted the Raiders in 2024, Raiders defensive end Maxx Crosby helped set up an early Miami touchdown by drawing an unnecessary roughness penalty for taking a swipe at Dolphins guard Liam Eichenberg.
